title: Spriggans
subtitle: A 5E-compatible fae greenwood ancestry and campaign supplement
fulfillmentNote: Digital PDF delivery will be handled directly by Tobacco Road Games after payment confirmation while the first-party storefront comes online.
shortDescription: Playable fae greenwood folk for 5E-compatible fantasy roleplaying.
longDescription: Spriggans presents a complete playable ancestry, kindred cultures, grove lore, fire-scar rules, Recognition, adventure hooks, and campaign-facing support for bringing ancient woodland people into your game.
features: Oak-Kin, Hazel-Kin, Willow-Kin, and Rowan-Kin kindreds
Kin, Kith, Recognition, and grove culture
creationMethod: Human-authored by RV Sawyer. Production may include editing tools, layout tools, and generated or assisted artwork as disclosed by Tobacco Road Games.
legalNote: This work is 5E compatible and includes material used under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License from the SRD as credited in the product.
